text:
Noah (People Ops): Quick check — new hire Jasmine Park starts Mon. Need to confirm I-9 options, BG status, day-1 schedule (orientation + benefits), and whether we can do an early lunch for team intro. Can we run through checklist? :mag:
Erin (Hiring): I'll meet her at reception at 09:00. She said she'll bring a driver's license + SS card. That should be fine for I-9, right?
Noah (People Ops): Yes DL + SS card is an acceptable combo. We'll do I-9 verification at the kiosk. Please remind her to bring originals. Also she needs to e-sign W-4 & DD before payroll cutoff on Fri.
Samir (IT): Imaging slot booked 09:15-09:35. MacBook Air reserved. I'll label it "Jasmine P" and leave a spare USB-C adapter. MDM will prompt on first boot.
Dana (Facilities): Reception will have a welcome sign. I can reserve Conf A for 11:00-12:00 for the team intro + 30 min buffer. Do we want catering?
Noah (People Ops): If budget OK, light lunch (sandwich platter + GF option). Keep it small — expect 6 people. I'll approve if cost < $60.
onboard-bot: Background check link sent to jasmine.park@redwood.ai — status: consent received, screening underway. Reminder set in 4 hours.
Erin (Hiring): BG check sometimes takes 24-48 hours. If it's still pending, can we issue a temp badge for campus-only access so she can attend orientation?
Noah (People Ops): Yes — temporary badge allowed for orientation only. Permanent badge requires BG green. Add note in HRIS: "temp badge issued until BG clear".
Samir (IT): FYI — to issue temp badge we need candidate photo. Can reception take one on arrival?
Dana (Facilities): Yes, I'll take a quick photo at check-in and upload to the badge ticket.
Noah (People Ops): Also: benefits orientation at 10:30 in Conf B — will cover medical/401k/commuter. Please bring bank routing number for direct deposit.
Erin (Hiring): Jasmine requested a campus map in the invite — I'll attach directions to kiosk and the elevator procedure. Also she asked about parking. Any visitor permits?
Dana (Facilities): We can validate one visitor parking pass for Monday. I'll leave it at reception with the laptop. Shuttle from satellite lot runs at 08:40 if she prefers.
Samir (IT): If she can't make live MDM enrollment, we have a remote enrollment flow. But prefer on-site so we can join the MDM session to enroll company VPN and SSO.
Noah (People Ops): Action items: 1) Erin — meet reception 09:00 2) Samir — imaging 09:15 + leave adapter 3) Dana — temp badge + photo + visitor pass 4) Noah — send day-1 email with links to GoodHire, W-4, DD, and calendar with map & lunch note.
onboard-bot: Status update: screening in progress. No holds.
Erin (Hiring): I'll confirm lunch headcount by 09:30. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Noah (People Ops): Great — welcome Jasmine! I'll follow up with final checklist email tonight.
